observations: Viewed all five sampled stages from both external cameras and the wrist camera. The original metal portal remains on the added support; the arm approaches beside/above its upright, reaches the original microwave handle and withdraws at released_hold. The two external angles show the handle/door operation with partial rail and arm occlusion. Wrist frames show the nearby upright during approach and close appliance panel/handle crops later. No missing textures were apparent in these samples; the independent native task and contact audits establish completion.
